The '''Magnifying Glass''' allows the player to find [[Secret Notes]] while [[Hoes|tilling]] soil, chopping [[trees]], [[mining]], [[fishing]], or killing [[monsters]].

The Magnifying Glass is obtained by completing the [[Quests#A Winter Mystery|"A Winter Mystery" Quest]]. This quest is added to the journal after triggering a cutscene by entering the [[Bus Stop]] from [[The Farm]] during [[Winter]] between 6am and 4pm.  The cutscene depicts a "Shadow Guy" who is startled by the player, and runs away.

Completing the quest requires the player to interact with a bush next to the playground, left of the [[Community Center]], triggering another cutscene in which the Shadow Guy gives the player the Magnifying Glass. 

Once obtained, it can be found in the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab in [[the Player]]'s Menu.
